### Describe the bug
While reading through the source of MvcDiagnostics.cs I noticed on line 527-530
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/01c1d0613ec40c6bc12bdbdebfe7b03bd878868a/src/Mvc/Mvc.Core/src/Diagnostics/MvcDiagnostics.cs#L527-530
that 
```
            1 => new KeyValuePair<string, object>(nameof(Controller), Controller),
```
should probably be
```
            1 => new KeyValuePair<string, object>(nameof(Arguments), Arguments),
```
all other EventData derived classes index the constructor parameters, this was the only one that was different (copy paste error?)

### To Reproduce
N/A

### Further technical details
- ASP.NET Core version: 3.0.0+ (according to the github source)
